description: Predicate 4a UNSAT — no move defensible. Same three pricing moves but competitor response impacts are uniformly heavy across all postures (0.08-0.20 range) and the floor_threshold is tightened to 0.35. Even freemium's projected 0.40 share gets crushed to ~0.02 under the worst combined impact. Solver must return UNSAT — there is no move that survives the competitive response. Mirrors the channel-score-3 / content-calendar-3 negative-test pattern.
_unsat_note: Tight floor (0.35) plus heavy competitor responses (every posture in [0.08, 0.20]) make every move + response combo violate the inequality. UNSAT is the correct, expected output — the structure of the market provides no share-defensible move. Negative test mirrors content-calendar-3 / channel-score-3 / swot-priorities-3.
